result.reason: The added subsection reaches the preferred position by requiring up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Sparkling's data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent written certification of deletion. It leaves the existing termination and return-of-Garman-materials obligations intact and adds only the necessary exit obligations. The drafting is clear and professional, though using a defined term such as “Customer Data,” if available, would improve precision.
